credentialSecurity.title: Credential protection
credentialSecurity.meta: Authorize through Facebook. BikriPilot does not ask for your Facebook password. Page access tokens are encrypted with AES-256-GCM on our server and are not returned to the seller interface. You can revoke access in Facebook's Business Integrations settings.
credentialSecurity.courier: Saved API keys and secrets are encrypted with AES-256-GCM on our server. After saving, the seller interface receives masked key details, not your full credentials. Change or revoke keys through your courier provider when needed.
credentialSecurity.serverAccess: Our server decrypts credentials when calling the provider; this is not zero-knowledge storage. Protect your account with two-factor authentication and never share keys in chat.

1.question: Is my Facebook Page safe?
1.answer: BikriPilot uses the official Meta API and never asks for your Page password.

2.question: Does AI understand Banglish?
2.answer: Yes. AI is designed for Bangla, English, and Banglish conversations.

3.question: What happens after the free launch?
3.answer: Your data stays with you, and you can choose from the published plans when billing starts.

4.question: Which couriers are supported?
4.answer: Connections are designed for Steadfast, Pathao, and RedX.

5.question: Can my staff have limited access?
5.answer: Yes. Give teammates roles that match their work.

6.question: Can I cancel any time?
6.answer: Yes. CSV exports help you take your data with you.

7.question: Who can see my customer data?
7.answer: Only approved members of your shop. Network checks share counts only.

8.question: Do I need a computer?
8.answer: No. BikriPilot works on phones, tablets, and computers.

smsEmail.title: SMS & Email Notifications
smsEmail.description: Configure your personal BulkSMSBD gateway and custom SMTP email credentials to automatically send order updates and ledger reminders to your customers.
smsEmail.smsGatewayDesc: Deliver branded SMS directly to customer mobile phones. You pay your own BulkSMSBD credits with zero platform quotas or extra platform fees.
smsEmail.enableSmsDesc: Send SMS alerts according to your event triggers below.
smsEmail.emailGatewayDesc: Send professional HTML emails directly from your own domain/mail server (e.g. Google Workspace, Mailgun, Amazon SES, cPanel).
smsEmail.enableEmailDesc: Send customer emails when customer email is available.
smsEmail.triggersDesc: Select which channels (SMS and/or Email) fire for each business event. If a customer does not have an email address on file, email is cleanly skipped while SMS still delivers.
smsEmail.ledgerTagadaDesc: Send reminder SMS to customers when you click 'Send Tagada' from the Hisab Khata ledger.
smsEmail.logsDesc: Recent SMS and Email dispatches sent from your shop with live provider status.
smsEmail.manualDesc: Send instant custom SMS or HTML email directly to any phone number or email address through your verified gateways.
smsEmail.smsBrandingNote: Will automatically append: Powered By bikriopilot.com
smsEmail.emailBrandingNote: Will include shop header and bikriopilot.com footer
smsEmail.confirmWarning: Warning: Please make sure your entered gateway credentials are valid and trusted. Incorrect API keys or SMTP passwords will cause customer notification deliveries to fail. Do you want to activate this gateway now?
smsEmail.errSmsRequired: BulkSMSBD API Key and Sender ID are both required before enabling SMS notifications.
smsEmail.errSmtpRequired: SMTP Host, User, Password, and Sender Email are all required before enabling Email notifications.
